snippet.title: HYPNOS - Early Access RELEASE Trailer
snippet.description:
HYPNOS early access is NOW available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861210/HYPNOS/

HYPNOS is a first-person adventure and exploration game, set in a lovecraftian megastructure fever dream, developed by Redlock
Enter the Nameless City at the edge of Dreams. 
Follow the trail into the shadow of the Holy Mountain. Wander through realms where the laws of the universe break down as they yield to other forces. Walk the Path and embrace your destiny.

Feel free to add it to your Wishlist if you’d like to support us 😉
We also have a demo available if you want to step into the Dreamlands.
If you'd like to chat with us, here's a link to our Discord channel:
https://discord.gg/HHZs6pEeGH

We hope you enjoy the journey!
